Record navigation and scoped activity

Real browser captures from an isolated sandbox using synthetic records, September 10, 2026. No production connector or personal account was changed.

Owletto #1070 · Lobu #3466

  • Clicked See activity, switched to See connections, then Back: the record stays in place and its short ?peek=1 URL is restored.
  • Opened full activity from the peek, expanded Filters, and verified a real chart canvas across three populated date buckets.
  • Clicked a relationship to a nested record: the resulting route includes its parent project. The reverse relationship click returns to the original record. Incoming/outgoing and inaccessible-ancestor cases also have regressions.
  • Checked wide and 390px layouts. Connections coverage uses the real empty state; populated connection scoping is covered by isolated component tests, without provider setup.
  • A synthetic notification appeared in the inbox, opened its nested-record peek, and its unread count changed from 1 to 0. Local notification snapshot Back behavior is covered by five tests using a real router.
  • Full frontend suite: 2,259 passing tests. Notification overflow and stale-draft behavior are covered by real PostgreSQL integration tests; screenshots do not claim production inbox coverage.
